PhysicalLine.description: One line with a box and ordered OCR tokens.

fields.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.
fields.name: c

shape.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

fields.description: OCR tokens in line order; Impresso permits an empty list.
fields.name: t

shape.description: OCR tokens in line order; Impresso permits an empty list.

PhysicalLine.yaml:
PhysicalLine:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: >-
      One line with a box and ordered OCR tokens.
    annotations:
      impresso: >-
        page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].
      alto: >-
        ALTO 4.4 TextLine inside TextBlock.
      computed_id: >-
        <region id>-l<LLL>; LLL is the 1-based line position across all paragraphs of
        the region in order, zero-padded to three digits. See the module description.
    slots:
      - physical_box
    slot_usage:
      physical_box:
        required: true
    attributes:
      tokens:
        alias: t
        range: PhysicalWord
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          OCR tokens in line order; Impresso permits an empty list.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t.
          alto: >-
            TextLine/String, with SP or HYP as appropriate for spacing and hyphenation.

fields.description: Whether legacy coordinates were converted or rescaled to the IIIF picture frame.
fields.name: cc

shape.description: Whether legacy coordinates were converted or rescaled to the IIIF picture frame.

fields.description: Legacy JSON creation timestamp; Impresso validates a string without a date format.
fields.name: cdt

shape.description: Legacy JSON creation timestamp; Impresso validates a string without a date format.

fields.description: Facsimile height in pixels; present together with fw, with no bound in Impresso.
fields.name: fh

shape.description: Facsimile height in pixels; present together with fw, with no bound in Impresso.

fields.description: Facsimile width in pixels; present together with fh, with no bound in Impresso.
fields.name: fw

shape.description: Facsimile width in pixels; present together with fh, with no bound in Impresso.

fields.description: Impresso's canonical page identifier; for example FABLE-1900-01-01-a-p0001.
fields.name: id

shape.description: Impresso's canonical page identifier; for example FABLE-1900-01-01-a-p0001.

fields.description: Deprecated IIIF manifest URI, retained for compatibility; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax. Exactly one of this and iiif_img_base_uri is present.
fields.name: iiif

shape.description: Deprecated IIIF manifest URI, retained for compatibility; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax. Exactly one of this and iiif_img_base_uri is present.

fields.description: Base IIIF image URI without a suffix; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax.
fields.name: iiif_img_base_uri

shape.description: Base IIIF image URI without a suffix; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax.

fields.description: Regions in page order; an empty list is accepted by Impresso.
fields.name: r

shape.description: Regions in page order; an empty list is accepted by Impresso.

fields.description: Original source medium; present together with st.
fields.name: sm

shape.description: Original source medium; present together with st.

fields.description: Media source type; present together with sm. Newspaper requires print; radio_broadcast requires typescript.
fields.name: st

shape.description: Media source type; present together with sm. Newspaper requires print; radio_broadcast requires typescript.

fields.description: JSON creation timestamp, intended as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; Impresso imposes no format constraint. At least one of ts and cdt is present; both are allowed.
fields.name: ts

PhysicalPage.yaml:
PhysicalPage:
    tree_root: true
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: >-
      One Impresso page file, with its picture metadata and physical text hierarchy.
      Impresso allows unknown properties at every object level; no such properties are
      defined here. Exactly one image key and at least one timestamp key must be present.
    annotations:
      impresso: >-
        page.schema.json root, Printed Page.
      alto: >-
        ALTO 4.4 Layout/Page (PageType). A full ALTO document also needs Description,
        MeasurementUnit and PHYSICAL_IMG_NR, which this file does not directly store.
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        pattern: '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-[a-z]{1,2}-p[0-9]{4}$'
        description: >-
          Impresso's canonical page identifier; for example FABLE-1900-01-01-a-p0001.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json id, with its exact pattern.
          alto: >-
            Page/@ID after ensuring the ALTO XML ID lexical constraints.
      iiif:
        description: >-
          Deprecated IIIF manifest URI, retained for compatibility; Impresso validates
          plain text, not URI syntax. Exactly one of this and iiif_img_base_uri is present.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json iiif.
          alto: >-
            No direct equivalent: a manifest is not sourceImageInformation/fileName.
      iiif_img_base_uri:
        description: >-
          Base IIIF image URI without a suffix; Impresso validates plain text, not URI syntax.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json iiif_img_base_uri.
          alto: >-
            Description/sourceImageInformation/fileName can identify the source picture;
            an image-service base URI needs an export policy to select the actual image.
      fw:
        range: integer
        description: >-
          Facsimile width in pixels; present together with fh, with no bound in Impresso.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json fw.
          alto: >-
            Page/@WIDTH with MeasurementUnit pixel.
      fh:
        range: integer
        description: >-
          Facsimile height in pixels; present together with fw, with no bound in Impresso.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json fh.
          alto: >-
            Page/@HEIGHT with MeasurementUnit pixel.
      st:
        equals_string_in:
          - newspaper
          - radio_broadcast
          - radio_magazine
          - radio_schedule
          - monograph
          - encyclopedia
        description: >-
          Media source type; present together with sm. Newspaper requires print;
          radio_broadcast requires typescript.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json st, SourceType values.
          alto: >-
            No direct ALTO page attribute for this source classification.
      sm:
        equals_string_in:
          - print
          - typescript
        description: >-
          Original source medium; present together with st.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json sm.
          alto: >-
            No direct equivalent; Page/@PAGECLASS is user-defined, not this enumeration.
      cc:
        range: boolean
        description: >-
          Whether legacy coordinates were converted or rescaled to the IIIF picture frame.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json cc.
          alto: >-
            No direct flag; an export must resolve coordinates in its MeasurementUnit
            and source picture frame before writing HPOS, VPOS, WIDTH and HEIGHT.
      cdt:
        description: >-
          Legacy JSON creation timestamp; Impresso validates a string without a date format.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json cdt.
          alto: >-
            Processing/processingStep/processingDateTime only if that step created this file;
            a JSON file timestamp is not necessarily an OCR processing time.
      ts:
        description: >-
          JSON creation timestamp, intended as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; Impresso imposes no
          format constraint. At least one of ts and cdt is present; both are allowed.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json ts.
          alto: >-
            Processing/processingStep/processingDateTime only for the corresponding creation
            step, with export-time conversion if needed.
      regions:
        alias: r
        range: PhysicalRegion
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          Regions in page order; an empty list is accepted by Impresso.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r.
          alto: >-
            Page/PrintSpace/TextBlock in order; this module adds no ALTO ReadingOrder field.
    exactly_one_of:
      - slot_conditions:
          iiif:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          iiif_img_base_uri:
            required: true
    any_of:
      - slot_conditions:
          ts:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          cdt:
            required: true
    rules:
      - preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            fw:
              required: true
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            fh:
              required: true
      - preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            fh:
              required: true
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            fw:
              required: true
      - preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            st:
              required: true
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            sm:
              required: true
      - preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            sm:
              required: true
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            st:
              required: true
      - preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            st:
              required: false
              equals_string: newspaper
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            sm:
              required: false
              equals_string: print
      - preconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            st:
              required: false
              equals_string: radio_broadcast
        postconditions:
          slot_conditions:
            sm:
              required: false
              equals_string: typescript

PhysicalParagraph.description: One ordered group of lines in a region, optionally with its own box; no computed id is assigned to paragraphs by this contract.

fields.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.
fields.name: c

shape.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

fields.description: Lines in paragraph order, including an empty list if stored that way.
fields.name: l

shape.description: Lines in paragraph order, including an empty list if stored that way.

PhysicalParagraph.yaml:
PhysicalParagraph:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: >-
      One ordered group of lines in a region, optionally with its own box; no computed id
      is assigned to paragraphs by this contract.
    annotations:
      impresso: >-
        page.schema.json r[].p[].
      alto: >-
        ALTO 4.4 has no paragraph wrapper between TextBlock and TextLine; its lines are
        flattened into their region's TextBlock. A paragraph box has no separate target.
    slots:
      - physical_box
    attributes:
      lines:
        alias: l
        range: PhysicalLine
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          Lines in paragraph order, including an empty list if stored that way.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l.
          alto: >-
            TextBlock/TextLine in the paragraphs' combined order.

PhysicalRegion.description: One region of the page, with a box, ordered paragraphs and optional semantic links.

fields.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.
fields.name: c

shape.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

fields.description: Paragraphs in region order; Impresso permits zero, one or several.
fields.name: p

shape.description: Paragraphs in region order; Impresso permits zero, one or several.

fields.description: Canonical content-item id, absent or null when no item is assigned.
fields.name: pOf

shape.description: Canonical content-item id, absent or null when no item is assigned.

fields.description: Content-item ids grouped by this section-heading region. The list may be absent or null; Impresso also permits null members and empty lists.
fields.name: section_pOf

shape.description: Content-item ids grouped by this section-heading region. The list may be absent or null; Impresso also permits null members and empty lists.

PhysicalRegion.yaml:
PhysicalRegion:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: >-
      One region of the page, with a box, ordered paragraphs and optional semantic links.
    annotations:
      impresso: >-
        page.schema.json r[].
      alto: >-
        ALTO 4.4 TextBlock (TextBlockType), normally inside PrintSpace.
      computed_id: >-
        <page id>-r<RRR>; RRR is the 1-based r position, zero-padded to three digits.
        See the module description for the 999 limit and segmentation lifecycle.
    slots:
      - physical_box
    slot_usage:
      physical_box:
        required: true
    attributes:
      paragraphs:
        alias: p
        range: PhysicalParagraph
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        required: true
        description: >-
          Paragraphs in region order; Impresso permits zero, one or several.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p.
          alto: >-
            No intermediate paragraph element between TextBlock and TextLine; flatten
            the paragraphs' lines in order when exporting this region as a TextBlock.
      part_of:
        alias: pOf
        description: >-
          Canonical content-item id, absent or null when no item is assigned.
        annotations:
          nullable: true
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].pOf.
          alto: >-
            No direct semantic content-item property on TextBlock; linking belongs to
            a companion logical structure such as METS, outside this module.
      section_part_of:
        alias: section_pOf
        multivalued: true
        description: >-
          Content-item ids grouped by this section-heading region. The list may be absent
          or null; Impresso also permits null members and empty lists.
        annotations:
          nullable: true
          nullable_items: true
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].section_pOf.
          alto: >-
            No direct ALTO equivalent for a section's semantic content-item membership.

PhysicalWord.description: One OCR token (a word or word part), with its own box and surface text.

fields.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.
fields.name: c

shape.description: A box [x, y, width, height] in pixels of this page's picture, with origin at its upper left. Impresso requires exactly four integers, without a nonnegative or positive bound. It is an array, not an object with invented coordinate fields.

fields.description: Glue next: true means no following whitespace. When absent readers assume false; the schema inserts no default.
fields.name: gn

shape.description: Glue next: true means no following whitespace. When absent readers assume false; the schema inserts no default.

fields.description: Whether this token is the first part of a hyphenated word, including the hyphen. Readers assume false when absent; the schema inserts no default.
fields.name: hy

shape.description: Whether this token is the first part of a hyphenated word, including the hyphen. Readers assume false when absent; the schema inserts no default.

fields.description: Normalized dehyphenated form on the latter part or parts of a hyphenated word.
fields.name: nf

shape.description: Normalized dehyphenated form on the latter part or parts of a hyphenated word.

fields.description: Style id in the separate issue file's s list; no style fields are added here.
fields.name: s

shape.description: Style id in the separate issue file's s list; no style fields are added here.

fields.description: Token surface text, including empty text if stored that way.
fields.name: tx

shape.description: Token surface text, including empty text if stored that way.

PhysicalWord.yaml:
PhysicalWord:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: >-
      One OCR token (a word or word part), with its own box and surface text.
    annotations:
      impresso: >-
        page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t[].
      alto: >-
        ALTO 4.4 String (StringType).
      computed_id: >-
        <line id>-w<WWW>; WWW is the 1-based t position, zero-padded to three digits.
        See the module description for the 999 limit and segmentation lifecycle.
    slots:
      - physical_box
    slot_usage:
      physical_box:
        required: true
    attributes:
      tx:
        required: true
        description: >-
          Token surface text, including empty text if stored that way.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t[].tx.
          alto: >-
            String/@CONTENT.
      style:
        alias: s
        range: integer
        description: >-
          Style id in the separate issue file's s list; no style fields are added here.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t[].s; issue.schema.json s.
          alto: >-
            String/@STYLEREFS after mapping this numeric issue style id to an ALTO Styles ID.
      gn:
        range: boolean
        description: >-
          Glue next: true means no following whitespace. When absent readers assume false;
          the schema inserts no default.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t[].gn.
          alto: >-
            Omit the intervening SP when true; no equivalent boolean on String.
      hy:
        range: boolean
        description: >-
          Whether this token is the first part of a hyphenated word, including the hyphen.
          Readers assume false when absent; the schema inserts no default.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t[].hy.
          alto: >-
            String/@SUBS_TYPE HypPart1; an export must handle a trailing HYP consistently.
      nf:
        description: >-
          Normalized dehyphenated form on the latter part or parts of a hyphenated word.
        annotations:
          impresso: >-
            page.schema.json r[].p[].l[].t[].nf.
          alto: >-
            String/@SUBS_CONTENT with SUBS_TYPE HypPart2 for the latter part.
